nodes.name: NF Pretreatment
nodes.procedure: A piece of NF (2 cm × 4 cm × 1.6 mm) was firstly pretreated by acetone and HCl (3 M) immersion for 10 min, and washing with water and ethanol. After drying in vacuum oven, the clean NF was obtained.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal Synthesis of NF/CoMoS
nodes.procedure: The clean NF was placed into a 50 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave containing 40 mL solution prepared by dissolving 0.4 mmol of CoSO4·7H2O, 0.4 mmol of Na2MoO4·2H2O, and 1.6 mmol of thiourea into 40 mL deionized water (n_Co+Mo/n_thiourea = 2). The autoclave was heated to 180 °C and held for 18 h. After cooling, washing with water/ethanol, and drying at 60 °C for 6 h in vacuum, NF/CoMoS was obtained. By adjusting Co/Mo ratios (3:2, 2:3, 1:3), NF/CoMoS-32, NF/CoMoS-23, NF/CoMoS-13 were prepared. For NF/CoS and NF/MoS, n_metal/n_thiourea was changed to 1:4.

nodes.source_text: the clean NF was placed into a 50 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave containing 40 mL solution... the black Ni3S2@CoMoS4 sample (denoted as NF/CoMoS) was successfully obtained

nodes.name: Electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: The obtained sample was transferred into a three-electrode system with the electrolyte containing 0.15 M FeSO4·7H2O and 0.15 M Ni(NO3)2·6H2O to conduct electrodeposition at a potential of -1.0 V vs. Ag/AgCl for 100 s. After washing and drying, the Ni3S2@CoMoS4/NiFeOOH catalyst loaded on NF (denoted as NF/CoMoS/NiFeOOH) was finally achieved.

nodes.characterization_summary: All samples show Ni (111), (200), (220) from NF substrate and Ni3S2 (101), (110), (003), (113), (211), (300) planes; NF/CoMoS/NiFeOOH has imperceptible NiFeOOH (006), (009) peaks at ~23° and 34°; no clear MoS2 peaks due to low crystallinity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: It's found that all the samples have three strong diffraction peaks emerged at 44.5°, 51.8°, and 76.4° ... corresponding to Ni (111), (200), and (220) planes ... All samples also possess clear diffraction peaks at 21.8°, 31.1°, 37.8°, 49.8°, 50.1°, and 55.3° identified as the Ni3S2 (101), (110), (003), (113), (211), and (300) planes...

nodes.characterization_summary: NF/CoMoS/NiFeOOH shows Ni3S2 peak at 219 cm⁻¹, CoMoS4 peaks at 817, 887, 939 cm⁻¹, and NiFeOOH peaks at 476 and 522 cm⁻¹; NF/CoMoS shows Ni3S2 and CoMoS4 peaks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 1b gives Raman spectra of NF/CoMoS and NF/CoMoS/NiFeOOH samples. Both sample has the peaks at 219 cm⁻¹ corresponding to the generated Ni3S2 phase...

nodes.characterization_summary: NF/CoMoS shows rough nanorods and attached irregular polyhedrons; NF/CoMoS/NiFeOOH shows nanorod arrays uniformly surrounded by nanopetals forming crisscross open network.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The NF/CoMoS prepared by adding both the Co and Mo precursors were observed to two shapes including the rough nanorods and the attached irregular polyhedrons (Fig. 2a and Fig. 2b) ... Fig. 3a and Fig. S5 give the FESEM images for NF/CoMoS/NiFeOOH, exhibiting that the nanorod arrays are uniformly surrounded by nanopetals...

nodes.characterization_summary: NF/CoMoS: Ni3S2 nanorod core (~130 nm diameter) surrounded by loose CoMoS4 nanosheets; NF/CoMoS/NiFeOOH: layer-by-layer coaxial structure with total diameter ~1.02 μm (Ni3S2 core, CoMoS4 interlayer, NiFeOOH outer network).
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM image in Fig. 2c clearly exhibits a well-regulated Ni3S2 nanorod surrounded by some loose CoMoS4 nanosheets (with a diameter of about 130 nm) ... TEM image in Fig. 3c shows a layer by layer coaxial nanorod structure with a diameter of about 1.02 μm...

nodes.characterization_summary: NF/CoMoS/NiFeOOH shows Co 2p (778.0-778.5 eV Co-S, positive shift), Mo 3d (Mo⁴⁺/Mo⁶⁺ ratio 1:6.3), S 2p (S-O, S-Ni, Co-S, Mo-S), Ni 2p (negative shift ~0.3 eV), Fe 2p (negative shift ~0.6 eV) confirming electronic interactions.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XPS was used to analysis the chemical species and states on the surface of NF/CoMoS and NF/CoMoS/NiFe-LDH materials... NF/CoMoS/NiFeOOH exhibit negative shifts... proving once again the interaction between CoMoS and NiFeOOH interface.
